spans.s: केरलः [kēralḥ], (pl.) N. of a country (in the south of India, the modern Malabar) and its inhabitants;
. -ली A woman of the Kerala country; कर्णाटीनां मुषितमुरलीकेरलीहारलीलः (राजेन्द्रकर्णपूरः).
A Hora or period of time equal to one hour. -Comp. -जातकम्, -तन्त्रम्, -सिद्धान्तः N. of works.
केरी [kērī], An unknown tree or shrub (perhaps cyperus hexastychus communis); Mātaṅga
